content: The Orthodox Church of St. Euphrosyne is a Russian Orthodox church located in Białystok, Poland. Białystok is the largest city in northeastern Poland. The church was built in the late 19th century and is dedicated to St. Euphrosyne of Polotsk, a 12th century Belarusian saint. That is the extent of factual information I can confidently provide about this specific Orthodox church based on my current knowledge.
